/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-zh.s.caption: 圖 1｜ICMP 探測：三種結果，三種證據
/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-zh.s.description: 收到回音、收到錯誤、未收到預期回覆，分別記錄。虛線表示已送探測但交付與回覆狀態未確認。

panels.title: 01｜有 Echo Reply
panels.claim: 能說：當時 Echo 往返通訊可達
notes: RTT 可觀察當次往返延遲。
仍需另查：網站、登入與應用服務是否正常。

panels.title: 02｜有 ICMP 錯誤
panels.claim: 能說：有設備回報交付問題
notes: 例如 Destination Unreachable 或 Time Exceeded。
記錄 Type、Code、回報來源；也可能由本機或其他設備回報。

panels.title: 03｜等待逾時
panels.claim: 能說：期限內未收到預期回覆
notes: 可能有遺失、路由、政策、休眠或其他原因。
不能直接宣稱主機已關機。

/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-zh.s.footer: 判讀原則：記錄來源、目標、時間、次數、等待條件與回覆來源。

/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-zh.sv.caption: 圖 2｜ARP：找本地下一站的 MAC
/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-zh.sv.description: IPv4 描述目的地；乙太網路訊框的 MAC 描述這一段交給誰。

panels.title: 情境 A｜同一條本地鏈路
panels.claim: 需要解析時，A 廣播詢問誰使用 192.168.1.20；圖中只畫出 B。
notes: B 回覆自己的 IPv4／MAC 對應。
訊框目的 MAC：B 的 MAC

panels.title: 情境 B｜目的地在遠端
panels.claim: 路由選擇預設閘道時，A 以 ARP 查詢 192.168.1.1。
notes: 此處箭頭表示資料交付，不是 ARP 跨路由器。
第一段訊框目的 MAC：閘道的 MAC

/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-zh.sv.footer: 條件：一般 IPv4 乙太網路、A 為 /24，依路由表選下一站。VLAN、Proxy ARP 等配置須另行判斷。

/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-en.s.caption: Figure 1 | ICMP: three outcomes, three kinds of evidence
/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-en.s.description: Record an echo, an error, and no expected reply separately. A dashed arrow means a probe was sent, with delivery and response unconfirmed.

panels.title: 01 | Echo Reply received
panels.claim: Supported: Echo round-trip reachability at that time
notes: RTT describes this round-trip delay.
Check website, login, and application functionality separately.

panels.title: 02 | ICMP error received
panels.claim: Supported: a device reported a delivery problem
notes: For example, Destination Unreachable or Time Exceeded.
Record Type, Code, and source; the reporter can also be the local stack or another device.

panels.title: 03 | Timeout
panels.claim: Supported: no expected reply within the wait
notes: Loss, routing, policy, sleep, or other causes remain possible.
Power-off is not established.

/images/ceh/m03-02-05-icmp-outcomes-en.s.footer: Record source, target, time, count, waiting conditions, and responder.

/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-en.sv.caption: Figure 2 | ARP resolves the local next hop
/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-en.sv.description: IPv4 identifies the destination; the Ethernet destination MAC identifies the recipient on this link.

panels.title: A | Same local link
panels.claim: When resolution is needed, A broadcasts for 192.168.1.20; only B is drawn.
notes: B replies with its IPv4/MAC mapping.
Final destination IP: 192.168.1.20
Frame destination MAC: B’s MAC

panels.title: B | Remote destination
panels.claim: If routing selects the default gateway, A resolves 192.168.1.1 with ARP.
notes: These arrows show data delivery, not ARP crossing a router.
Final destination IP: 203.0.113.20
First frame destination MAC: gateway’s MAC

/images/ceh/m03-02-06-arp-next-hop-en.sv.footer: Assumptions: ordinary IPv4 Ethernet, A uses /24, and routes select the next hop. Assess VLANs and proxy ARP separately.
